title: Military buildup z-score leads ITA
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT Iran conflict daily event count 20d z-score > 1 leads defense ETF returns by 3-5 days (+); trade long ITA 5d [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.ITA.log_return] (parent: R2-0085)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ITA next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 6 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT Iran fight_events 20d z-score > 1.5 leads defense ETF realized volatility (not direction) by 1-3 days (+); trade long ITA straddle proxy 3d [gdelt.irn.fight_events -> finance.ITA.abs_return] (parent: R2-0186)
